gates.rule: the facility has a location we can use
claims the service and is within 150 km (3 x the 50 km radius)
supported or corroborated by facts in the record, and no blocking warning
at least one recommendable facility within 50 km, else no reliable option nearby

how_we_decided.formula: score = 0.5 x evidence + 0.3 x distance + 0.2 x trust - penalties. evidence: supported 0.7 or corroborated 1.0, minus 0.2 if the evidence is thin, plus 0.1 if strong, capped at 1. distance: exp(-km / radius). trust: source confidence from distinct web domains, an official website, page recency and named staff. penalties: possible merged record 0.15, minor location conflict 0.10.
how_we_decided.tie_rule: Scores within 0.02 are ties, broken by distance.
how_we_decided.order_rule: Facilities inside the service radius are listed before any beyond it; within each group, by score. A higher score beyond the radius never pushes a facility inside the radius off the list.
limits: Distances are straight-line km, not travel time, measured from the point the place name resolved to.
The data is a sample of mostly private, web-visible facilities. Public hospitals are under-covered, so no result often means not in this data.
Grades describe what web pages say, not what a facility can do today. Pages can be stale.
Citations name the fact and its field, not the web page it came from: the data has no per-fact source.
Weights and radii are stated defaults, not fitted or clinically validated.
notes: The score is provisional: its weights, radii and penalties are stated defaults, not measured.
